newsitem.title: USA: NFL-COWBOYS COACH SWITZER ARRESTED ON AIRPORT GUN CHARGE.
newsitem.headline: NFL-COWBOYS COACH SWITZER ARRESTED ON AIRPORT GUN CHARGE.

text.p: Dallas Cowboys head coach Barry Switzer was arrested Monday and faces gun possession charges after a loaded pistol was found in his carry-on luggage at Dallas-Forth Worth International Airport.

Airport spokeswoman Angel Biasatti said the .38 calibre handgun was discovered at a terminal check point as Switzer prepared to board a plane to Austin, Texas, where the team is in pre-season training camp.
"It is illegal to carry a gun in an airport," she said.
The offence is a third-degree felony punishable by two to 10 years in jail and a $10,000 fine.
She said airport police would "probably" file charges against Switzer, although it was not clear if he knew the gun was inside his bag.
"It may have been unintentional. He apparently didn't know it was there," Biasatti said.
Switzer was detained for almost two hours before being released on his own recognisance. He then continued on to Austin.

Ironically, Switzer and team owner Jerry Jones have this year imposed a tight new regime at training camp in a bid put an end to the off-the-field problems that have plagued the Cowboys in recent years and clean up the team's image.
The Cowboys opened their preseason on Sunday night with a 34-27 loss to the Oakland Raiders at Texas Stadium.
Switzer is in his fourth season as Cowboys head coach and won a Super Bowl title with the team in 1995.
